clue.text: Old girl, one getting on, missing out

parts.note: a miss is a young girl
I is the Roman numeral for one
on, as in getting on a bus, gives the word ON

explanation.surface: An old girl, one who is getting on in years, feels left out of things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old girl' suggests a former pupil or an elderly woman, but it splits into O and MISS.
explanation.definitionFit: A noun-phrase sense: an omission is a leaving out, the act of missing something out.

clue.text: Unusual teatimes having most of one sort of food

definitions.text: having most of one sort of food

indicators.note: unusual signals that the letters of teatimes are set out in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Odd teatimes where most of the menu is a single kind of dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of meaty: a dish with the greatest share of flesh, one particular sort of food.

clue.text: Sporting venue associated with water polo possibly!

definitions.text: Sporting venue associated with water polo possibly!

parts.words: Sporting venue associated with water polo possibly!
parts.note: water polo is played in a tank of water built for swimmers; the exclamation also hints that POLO rearranged gives the second word

explanation.surface: A quiz-style question about where a particular aquatic sport takes place.
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation mark flags the extra joke: 'polo possibly' rearranges to the final four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Water polo matches are held in a large water-filled tank at a leisure centre or baths.

clue.text: Trendy, on end of street, a Parisian flat? No!

parts.note: in means fashionable, trendy

indicators.note: the end of the word street is its final letter

parts.note: une is French for a, as a Parisian would say it

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a fashionable street-end apartment in Paris counts as a flat, and is told no.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' looks like an apartment, but here it is the musical sense: something not flat is pitched correctly.
explanation.definitionFit: A note that is not flat is pitched correctly, so the singer is harmonious and on key.

clue.text: Nothing these days arrives on time

parts.note: now means at present, these days

explanation.surface: These days nothing turns up punctually.
explanation.walkthrough: NOWT is northern English dialect for nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Northern English dialect word meaning zero, not a thing.

clue.text: This person, bad, holding firm up? Neither bad nor good

parts.note: this person, said by the setter, is me

indicators.note: holding means the word for bad contains the other piece

parts.note: dire means very bad

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: Someone admits they are bad at propping up a business and so are merely average.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' appears twice: once inside the wordplay and once in the definition, a deliberate echo by the setter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something middling or average is ordinary, of only moderate quality.

clue.text: Piano composer not the first or last in a native group

indicators.note: the composer's name loses its opening and closing letters

parts.note: Frederic Chopin is the great Polish composer for the piano

explanation.surface: A piano composer is neither first nor last within an indigenous community.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hopi are a Native American people of northeastern Arizona.

clue.text: Go through with soldiers sitting on 'final' vehicle

indicators.note: in a down clue, sitting on puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of soldiers
a hearse is the vehicle for one's final journey

explanation.surface: Troops ride on a funeral car while running through their routine.
explanation.definitionFit: To practise a play or speech is to go through it beforehand.

clue.text: Sequence of individual's autobiography?

parts.note: an autobiography is a book about a single person written by that same person, which describes the phrase for a sequence of single steps

explanation.surface: A question about the order of events in someone's memoir.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the phrase literally: a life story is about a person and by that person.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means individually, in sequence, taking each item singly in turn.

clue.text: Holiday location — mostly 'dance island'?

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A resort described as basically a dancing island.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indonesian island is a popular tourist destination for beach holidays.

clue.text: Maidens out in winds where snow and ice may be evident?

definitions.text: where snow and ice may be evident?

indicators.note: winds, as a verb, means twists about, so the letters are wound into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Young women outside in a gale on a wintry slope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winds' reads as gusts of air, but it is the verb that twists the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The slopes of a high peak are where snowfields and glaciers are found.

clue.text: Something dramatic not everyone will pick up

definitions.text: Something dramatic not everyone will pick up

parts.words: Something dramatic not everyone will pick up
parts.note: a theatrical aside spoken softly, supposedly unheard by other characters on stage

explanation.surface: A dramatic gesture that only some will notice.
explanation.definitionFit: In theatre, an actor's loud aside is meant for the audience yet supposedly inaudible to other characters.

clue.text: Shop with endless lines in bowls?

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen, a shop

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: verse is lines of poetry

explanation.surface: A shop where queues of customers snake around the bowling green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bowls' looks like dishes or the lawn game, but it is the cricket verb: a bowler sends down the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a bowler hands over the ball to the batsman; both verbs describe sending it down.

clue.text: Rage of street men prepared to fight about nothing

parts.note: O is zero, nothing
RM is the Royal Marines, fighting men

explanation.surface: Angry men on the street ready to brawl over nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to rage is to rant furiously, like a tempest.

clue.text: My covering had to be head cloth

indicators.note: covering means the exclamation goes around the other word

parts.note: cor is an exclamation of surprise, like my!
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone's head covering had to be a simple cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' reads as a possessive, but it is the exclamation COR.
explanation.definitionFit: A chador is a large cloth worn by some Muslim women to cover head and body.

clue.text: Male animal with leg cut

indicators.note: cut means the word is shortened by its last letter

parts.note: a stage is a leg of a journey

explanation.surface: A male beast with an injured leg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leg' suggests a limb, but it is a stretch of a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A male deer, specifically an adult red deer, is a buck of this name.

clue.text: Occasional crop said to be unreliable

indicators.note: the letters are unreliable, not staying in order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A harvest reported as unreliable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something irregular or intermittent happens only now and then.

clue.text: Where stone was taken from food item

definitions.meaning: the Stone of Destiny was taken from the Scottish abbey at this place by Edward I in 1296
a small baked cake eaten with butter or jam

explanation.surface: Where a stone was removed from a piece of food, like a fruit stone.
explanation.walkthrough: The Stone of Scone is the Scottish coronation stone, removed to Westminster by Edward I.
explanation.definitionFit: A double definition: a Scottish village of coronation history and a small baked teatime cake.

clue.text: Note ascending space vehicle — there's a rotating mechanism

indicators.note: in a down clue, ascending means the letters read upwards

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a note added to a letter
a rocket is a space vehicle

explanation.surface: A musical note rises as a spacecraft launches, with machinery turning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' suggests music, but it is PS, a postscript, turned to SP.
explanation.definitionFit: A toothed wheel engaging a chain or film perforations, turning as part of a drive.

clue.text: Language of ranter sermonising

indicators.note: of signals the language is taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: The way a preacher talks while ranting in a sermon.
explanation.definitionFit: Erse is an old name for the Gaelic tongue of Scotland or Ireland.

clue.text: Wholesale activity to remove dirt?

definitions.meaning: wholesale means extensive, across the board
brushing a floor clean with a broom

explanation.surface: Bulk trade as a cleaning job.
explanation.definitionFit: A double definition: far-reaching in scope, and brushing dust away with a broom.

clue.text: Line on map leader ignored travelling from place to place

indicators.note: the word's first letter, its leader, is dropped

parts.note: a contour is a line on a map joining points of equal height

explanation.surface: A map line ignored by a guide while moving around.
explanation.definitionFit: A band or team visiting several venues in succession is out playing dates.

clue.text: Leader of men is boss in funny business?

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a chief is a boss

explanation.surface: The man in charge of the troops is the chief of a comedy firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Playful naughtiness or trouble-making is humorous misbehaviour, monkey business.

clue.text: Silly jokes about parking in capital city

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the other piece
silly means the letters of jokes are made nonsensical, rearranged

explanation.surface: Daft jokes about parking in a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Silly' rearranges JOKES as SKOJE, and 'about' wraps those letters round P.
explanation.definitionFit: Skopje is the capital city of North Macedonia.

clue.text: Requests for ointments?

definitions.meaning: formal requests, as for a job
creams or lotions put on the skin, things applied

explanation.surface: Asking for some balms.
explanation.definitionFit: A double definition: formal requests, and substances smeared on skin, playfully.

clue.text: Put surface material on quiet avenue

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Resurfacing a peaceful avenue.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay flagstones, tarmac or bricks over ground is to give it a hard covering.

clue.text: Tails up maybe after this?

parts.note: flipping a coin leaves either heads or tails facing upwards

explanation.surface: Something that leaves an animal's tail raised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tails' suggests animals, but it is the reverse of a coin.
explanation.definitionFit: Flipping a coin into the air ends with one face showing, maybe the reverse side.

clue.text: Facial expression of Greek character, last character in line-up?

parts.note: phi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
Z is the last character in the line-up of the alphabet

explanation.surface: The look on the face of a Greek person at the end of a police line-up.
explanation.walkthrough: Phiz is old slang for the face, short for physiognomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Old slang, short for physiognomy, meaning a person's face or look.

clue.text: Home (No. 6) by river — they've been asked along

parts.note: in means at home
VI is the Roman numeral for six
the Tees is a river in northeast England

explanation.surface: A house numbered six beside a river where guests have been summoned.
explanation.definitionFit: Guests are people who have received an invitation to come.

clue.text: Guidance to find cheap accommodation

definitions.meaning: the cheapest passenger quarters on a ship

explanation.surface: Advice on finding a budget room.
explanation.definitionFit: A double definition: the act of directing a ship, and its lowest-fare passenger quarters.
